gloss: promptly, right after; as soon as

definitions.explanation: Doing something quickly or immediately, without wasting time.
Used as a suffix after nouns indicating a time or event to mean 'right after' or 'as soon as.' Read as そうそう in this usage.

examples.japanese: {早々|そうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{上|あ}げた→切り上げる：06979_kiriageru⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{早々|そうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: As soon as the meeting ended, he went straight home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しかった→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧{早々|そうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}した→失礼する：15203_shitsureisuru⟧。
examples.english: I was busy, so I excused myself right after the greetings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧{早々|そうそう}、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{任|まか}された。
examples.english: Right after joining the company, I was entrusted with a big project.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧{早々|そうそう}、うれしい⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: Right at the start of the new year, good news arrived.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧{早々|そうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{客|きゃく}さん→お客さん：10253_okyakusan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っていた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Right after opening, customers were already lining up.

notes:
USAGE:
Two main patterns:
1. {早々|そうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb: promptly, without delay (adverbial)
2. Noun + {早々|そうそう}: right after [noun], as soon as [noun] (suffix)

The suffix pattern attaches to nouns representing events or time points: ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧{早々|そうそう} (right after joining), ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧{早々|そうそう} (right at the new year), ⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧{早々|そうそう} (right after arriving).

Note: This is different from the colloquial filler word そうそう (meaning 'oh right, that reminds me').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {早々|そうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧: to withdraw promptly
- ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧{早々|そうそう}: right at the start of the new year
- ⟦{入社|にゅうしゃ}→入社：03131_nyuusha⟧{早々|そうそう}: right after joining a company
